Base Device

Food

Normal meals are labeled as "Food", while cooked meals are labelled as "Meals". Cooking is a feature that is unlocked at a certain Planet Level, and all cooked meals become available to purchase in the Lab Shop at a later Planet Level. Liked foods add an additional +1 happiness, while disliked foods decreases happiness by -1.

Note that food with certain attributes for influencing growth will increase a hidden point value a certain amount per consumption, with 5 points needed to obtain a single food cell of that type.
